note: The viewer schema is declared by hand because `reward` and `meta` are key-bags whose keys change between rounds: the datasets-server infers `reward` from the four keys in `batch-r01.jsonl`, then cannot cast the later shards that add `handoff`/`xfailed` or `duration_min`/`retries`/`wasted_calls`, so the streaming preview works while the parquet index does not. Declaring the union fixes the index without rewriting a single historical raw record.

features.name: plan
features.note: present as a non-empty string on all 632 records; unlike some sibling datasets it is never absent here

struct.name: args
struct.note: always an object; keys differ per tool (`command`, `path`, `old`/`new`, `contents`, `url`, `pattern`, `target`, `args`)

features.name: reward
features.note: key-bag: `success`, `tests_passed`, `cost_steps` on all 632 records, `plan_changes` on 628, `handoff` and `xfailed` on 251, `duration_min`, `retries`, `wasted_calls` on 44

features.name: meta
features.note: key-bag: `factory`, `round`, `generator` on all 632 records, plus `kind` on 134, `plant` on 90, `designed`/`domain`/`seed`/`stack` on 44, `lane` on 2

disclosures: Every record is a `graphql-nplusone-factory` episode generated by `grok-4.6`, with ids all prefixed `gql-` and one round per shard across r01-r316. There is no leftover-mill mix and no dest-stamped foreign payload in this dataset; the word "leftover" in goals and outcomes describes the GraphQL bug under repair, not a foreign record.
Every step publishes a public `decision_basis`. There are no hidden `thought` or `internal_reasoning` fields.

`meta.kind` is inconsistent across rounds and should not be filtered on: it is absent on 498 records, `episode` on 44, and carries an outcome label (`success` on 45, `partial` on 45) on the remaining 90. The per-record outcome lives in `outcome` and `reward.success`; the `kind` values are kept exactly as generated.
